title: UPAS Artifact Descriptor Schema
description: Formal contract for abstract immutable artifacts in UPAS (container images, binaries, bundles).

schema_version.description: Version of the Artifact Descriptor schema.

artifact_id.description: Unique identifier for this artifact build instance.

artifact_type.description: Physical backend classification of the artifact.

canonical_reference.description: Authoritative immutable address strictly pinned by cryptographic digest. Mutable tags and double @ are forbidden.

immutable_digest.description: Cryptographic SHA256 content digest of the artifact (lowercase 64 hex chars).

source_commit.description: Full 40-character Git commit SHA from which the artifact was built.

source_branch.description: Git branch name at build time.

build_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of build completion.

ci_run_id.description: GitHub Actions run ID or equivalent CI execution ID.

runner_os.description: OS identifier of the build runner.

provenance_attestation.description: Cryptographic attestation reference (e.g. cosign bundle, in-toto attestation).

verified.description: Whether signature was verified during release gate.
